title: Alaska Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 10 - minimum paid sick leave benefit
verified_how: Same chapter table of contents as above (statutes.asp?media=js&type=TOC&title=23.10) lists live sections 23.10.066 'Minimum paid sick leave benefit', 23.10.067 'Utilization of paid sick leave benefit', 23.10.068 'Limitations, notice, and violations related to paid sick leave benefit' and 23.10.069 'Exemptions from paid sick leave benefit', in the 2025 edition of the statutes.
notes: These sections were added by the 2024 ballot measure and are recent; the effective date was not shown on the table of contents and should be checked against the section text. Alaska mandates no paid annual leave or holiday pay for private employers. The Alaska Family Leave Act was renumbered out of this chapter to AS 39.20.500-39.20.550 (shown on the register as 'Sec. 23.10.500 - 23.10.550. [Renumbered as AS 39.20.500 - 39.20.550.]') and covers public employment.
